data.notes: January 2027 is anchored by New Year circuit-festival spillover, K-pop arena dates, and Bangkok’s independent club/showcase ecosystem around Silom and Charoenkrung.

events.title: White Party Bangkok
events.venueName: Paragon Hall & Nex Hall, Siam Paragon / The River Club
events.summary: White Party Bangkok’s 10th-anniversary AmaXon edition runs six days across Siam Paragon venues and The River Club, continuing into January with circuit-dance parties and large-scale production.

events.title: STRAY KIDS WORLD TOUR <RUN IT BANGKOK>
events.summary: Stray Kids play two Bangkok arena shows on 16 and 17 January 2027 as part of the RUN IT world tour.

events.title: Bangkok Music City 2027
events.summary: Bangkok Music City returns on 30–31 January 2027 as a music conference and showcase festival featuring emerging artists and music-industry programming across the Charoenkrung Creative District.

events.title: Melt Livehouse Idea Live: St. Vincent
events.summary: St. Vincent headlines Melt Livehouse Idea Live at Bravo BKK on 22 January 2027.

events.title: Westlife 25: The Anniversary World Tour in Bangkok
events.summary: Westlife bring their 25th Anniversary World Tour to Impact Arena on 25 January 2027.

events.title: PARK JINYOUNG 1ST CONCERT TOUR [CODE#] IN BANGKOK
events.summary: Park Jinyoung brings his first full solo concert tour in Thailand to Impact Arena for two nights on 9–10 January 2027.

events.title: BOYNEXTDOOR TOUR 'KNOCK ON Vol.2' IN BANGKOK
events.summary: BOYNEXTDOOR bring the KNOCK ON Vol.2 tour to Impact Arena on 30 January 2027.

events.title: PHAHON FESTIVAL MUSIC AT ESC PARK RANGSIT
events.summary: Phahon Festival brings Thai pop, R&B, hip-hop, pop-indie, luk thung and DJ/EDM acts to ESC Park Rangsit on 30 January 2027, with listed artists including Lamyai Haithongkham, Zom Marie, Gavin D, URBOYTJ, Oat Pramote and PROXIE.

events.title: More Rice 10th Year Starts
events.summary: The kickoff for More Rice’s 10th year at Elsewhere; even with lineup still TBA, the label/promoter’s anniversary programming makes this a key underground Bangkok date to watch.

events.title: BLUE 25TH ANNIVERSARY TOUR
events.summary: British pop/R&B group Blue perform their 25th Anniversary Tour at UOB Live Emsphere on 26 January 2027.

events.title: Daft Funk Live Thailand Premier Tour 2027 — Bangkok
events.summary: The Bangkok stop of Daft Funk’s Thailand tour brings a full live-band Daft Punk tribute production to Mustache, leaning into French house, disco-house and electronic nostalgia in a proper club room.

events.title: 2026-27 ROY KIM LIVE TOUR [R:O:Y] in BANGKOK
events.summary: Roy Kim performs a Bangkok stop of his R:O:Y live tour at Phenix Grand Ballroom on 16 January 2027.

events.title: All Night Long: JIRUS
events.summary: Elsewhere’s January programme lists an All Night Long session with Bangkok selector JIRUS on 29 January 2027.

events.title: Chant Down Babylon
events.summary: A riverside reggae/roots/dancehall community night on Bangkok Island with Srirajah Rockers and Rootsman Creation, built around live bass-heavy grooves rather than a standard club format.

events.title: Centara Pool Party | 9 January
events.venueName: Pool Deck at Centara Grand at CentralWorld
events.summary: Bangkok Rooftops’ season-opening pool/day party, running 3pm–10pm with DJ sets, skyline sunset energy, and an official after-party upstairs at Cru Champagne Bar until 1am.

events.title: Elsewhere: DOTT + Etchar
events.summary: A Saturday late-night Elsewhere session pairing Bangkok underground fixture DOTT with Etchar, representative of the city’s more music-led house/techno club circuit.
